title: Hospital
imageAlt: Abandoned hospital exterior surrounded by dark trees
summary: The opening location where the Player wakes from a coma and first encounters the empty world.
intro: The Hospital is the first playable location in Omni. It feels clean, quiet, and wrong because it appears abandoned rather than destroyed.
facts: The Player wakes here with no staff nearby.
The building contains early clues without explaining Omni immediately.
A later return reveals restricted records and observation rooms.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Hospital introduces Omni through absence. The rooms are intact, but the people who normally occupy them are gone.
The Player's first tasks are simple: leave the room, search for a working exit, and test whether the outside world is reachable.
The Hospital becomes more important after The Camp, when the Player can return with enough context to understand what was strange from the beginning.
items: Key interactions: doors, notes, phones, patient files.
Late use: reveal the Player was not a normal patient.

sections.heading: Clues
paragraphs: Hospital clues are specific enough to reward inspection but incomplete enough to preserve the mystery.
Useful clues include unusual patient labels, staff notes about visitors, locked observation rooms, and audio fragments that mention Omni without defining it.
The strongest reveal is not that the hospital caused everything, but that it recorded signs of the almost-human problem before the Player woke up.
items: Patient files connect the Player to missing time.
Staff audio can mention repeated phrases or copied voices.
A locked wing becomes the reason to return later.
